## Download

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `ToTAK-@VERSION@-windows-Setup.exe` |
| macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) | `ToTAK-@VERSION@-macos.dmg` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `ToTAK-@VERSION@-linux-debian-ubuntu-amd64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL and derivatives | `ToTAK-@VERSION@-linux-fedora-opensuse-x86_64.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `ToTAK-@VERSION@-linux-arch-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` |
| Any other Linux x86_64 | `ToTAK-@VERSION@-linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `.tar.gz` |

Install commands, upgrades and troubleshooting are in the [README](https://github.com/AWeebTaku/ToTAK#download-and-install).
Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`.
